neighbours.label: a verb of finding out or knowing that introduces what was learned (we've found that, discovered that, have learned that, believes that); the + pole takes verbs of saying (said, boasted of, bragging about)
fire: After thirty years of teaching, I've found that children learn best through play.
In the course of her fieldwork she discovered that the frogs sing only at dusk.
Through long experience, we have learned that cheap paint never lasts.
The clinic believes that early screening saves lives.
Working with hundreds of clients, we've found that small habits matter most.
While sorting the archive, he discovered that two letters were missing.
Our engineers have learned that simple designs break less often.
Having tested dozens of soils, the lab found that clay holds water longest.
quiet: After thirty years of teaching, I've said that children learn best through play.
At the end of her lecture she announced that the frogs sing only at dusk.
At every meeting, we have repeated that cheap paint never lasts.
The clinic stated that early screening saves lives.
Speaking to hundreds of clients, we've stressed that small habits matter most.
While closing the archive, he mentioned that two letters were missing.
Our engineers have complained that simple designs sell less often.
Having tested dozens of soils, the lab reported that clay holds water longest.

notes: Probe: 'we've found that' 0.55, 'discovered that' 0.30, 'learned that' 0.29, 'believes that' 0.22, 'realized' 0.14, 'knows about' 0.14; 'we've announced that' 0.06, 'said that' 0.02. The margin over the 0.20 median bar is thin.
